geometry.note: Reactor containment building at the Hanbit (Yonggwang) Nuclear Power Plant, identified in OpenStreetMap by power=generator, generator:source=nuclear. The assignment to reactor number R2 (of 6, numbered geographically southwest to northeast) is inferred from which numbering direction gives the best nonlinear least-squares fit of the RENO proposal's per-reactor near/far detector distances (arXiv:1003.1391 Table 1.2) against these six OpenStreetMap building positions: residuals are under 6 m on distances of 300-1560 m for the southwest-to-northeast numbering, versus hundreds of metres for the reverse numbering or any other reactor-to-building permutation (the fit is described on the RENO near-detector point). The table gives no reactor coordinates; only the southwest-to-northeast physical order of the six buildings is used. This is not a claim about which of Hanbit's operator-assigned Units 1-6 each building is.

method: OpenStreetMap way 143990766 (power=generator, generator:source=nuclear), nodes kept verbatim from an Overpass extract.
